description: This U Green Shockproof Laptop Sleeve Case is the perfect accessory for your 13-13.3 inch laptop. With its shockproof design, your laptop will be protected from accidental drops and bumps. The sleeve is made of high-quality materials that are both durable and lightweight, making it easy to carry around. The sleek design is perfect for those who want to keep their laptop safe without sacrificing style. This laptop sleeve is compatible with Mac laptops and comes in a hard cover for added protection. Whether you're commuting to work or traveling, this laptop sleeve is a must-have accessory to keep your laptop safe and secure.
